document_title: The Every-day Life of Abraham Lincoln: A Narrative And Descriptive Biography With Pen-Pictures And Personal; Recollections By Those Who Knew Him
author: Francis F. Browne
claims: It was a momentous incident in the history of the Civil War.
It is considered one of the most enduring pieces of eloquence on the continent.
The address contained none of the tricks of oratory, scholarly learning, or the need for it.
People listened with marked attention to Lincoln's simple and touching eulogy.
There was scarcely a dry eye in the audience when Lincoln spoke.
Lincoln's address was delivered at the dedication of the National Cemetery at Gettysburg.
Edward Everett's oration preceded Lincoln's address.
